title: Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love’ Holds Court Atop U.K. Chart for Second Week
summary: Her third LP also earned the U.K.'s biggest opening week for an international album release in 2026.
contentText:
Olivia Rodrigo continues her reign over the U.K.’s Official Albums Chart , landing her second consecutive week at No. 1 with you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love on the list dated June 26 .

The third LP from the star soared straight to the summit on the June 19 chart to give the 23-year-old her third consecutive No. 1 album, following Sour (2021) and Guts (2023). Its opening run of 103,000 chart units doubled Sour ’s 51,000 units and Guts ’ 60,000 units in their respective first weeks; the project also secured the title of the U.K.’s biggest opening week for an international album release in 2026.

After launching the North American leg of her tour this fall, Rodrigo will head to London’s O2 Arena next spring for a U.K.-exclusive residency, performing 11 nights at the 20,000-capacity venue as part of The Unraveled Tour. She also recently announced Daisy Chain Fields , a festival supporting charities for women and girls, which will take place on Aug. 29 in Irvine, Calif., and feature Chappell Roan , Stevie Nicks , Doechii , KATSEYE and more.

BRIT-winning singer-songwriter Myles Smith follows at No. 2 with My Mess, My Heart, My Life , clinching the biggest opening week for a debut album in 2026 so far. The Luton-born artist’s first full-length project also earns Smith his first top 10 entry on the chart, after his 2024 EP  A Minute, A Moment…  peaked at No. 32.

Michael Jackson’s The Essential collection drops one position to No. 3. Harry Styles’ Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally is up eight places on last week to No. 4 as his 12-night run at London’s Wembley Stadium hits its halfway point, while Olivia Dean’s The Art of Loving rounds out the top five.

London alt-rock duo Placebo bags its 11th placement in the top 40 as  Placebo RE:CREATED   comes in at No. 14. And as U.K. festival season kicks into full swing, recent TRNSMT headliner Calvin Harris climbs 14 spots to No. 27 with his 2024 record 96 Months .
